methodology: Two born-digital English WHO excerpts, six pages each. Native PDF text and stock Docling (OCR off) use the text layer; Tesseract receives only 300-DPI page rasters. Anchors were checked against rendered excerpt pages 1-2; checks normalize whitespace and hyphenated line breaks. Anchor presence is a diagnostic, not medical correctness, table alignment, recall, CER or WER. FinePDFs itself is not a backend in this runner.
